parameters.query:
-- How far back to read: a day before the newest arrival we already have, or
-- a week back on the first check. The day of overlap catches anything the
-- archive filed late; Keep new drops what we already have.
SELECT coalesce(max(published_at) - interval '1 day', now() - interval '7 days') AS since
  FROM items
 WHERE source_id = $1::int;

-- Only what we do not have yet, newest first. The ingest API would turn a
-- repeat into an update anyway, but there is no reason to send it.
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.published_at DESC NULLS LAST), '[]'::jsonb) AS items
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
       url text, title text, published_at timestamptz, publisher text,
       source_language text, excerpt text, raw_text text,
       subjects jsonb, details jsonb)
 WHERE x.url IS NOT NULL
   AND x.title IS NOT NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items i
                    WHERE i.canonical_url = canonicalise_url(x.url));
